concerns_addressed: GET /api/admin/replenishment-plans and POST /api/admin/replenishment-plans/generate are absent at T14 HEAD; T14 scope is frontend only and T10 exposes approve/execute, so the missing backend list/generate wiring is deferred rather than a T14 violation. Integration gap remains for later backend/integration verification.

strengths: use client page with admin/platform_owner guard and session expiry handling.
Status-aware actions prevent execute before approved; terminal statuses have no actions.
Empty state, loading gate, summary, sorting, pagination, and role=alert error handling are covered.
All network access is delegated to replenishment-api.ts; no hardcoded URLs or direct fetch in page.tsx.
Executed PO references are rendered from execution_result.purchase_orders[].reference and execute carries an idempotency key.

issues.description: Duplicate verifyAdminAccess helper could be extracted later to avoid drift.
Dummy execute/generate identifiers use Date.now()/Math.random(), reducing deterministic dummy reproducibility.
PO reference parsing uses defensive any casts; typed guards could improve strictness.
